provider: FamilySearch Catalog and authenticated image viewer
question: Do the FamilySearch Zaporizhia revision-list collection or catalog 1282852 contain the 1816, 1835, or 1850 revision of Tymoshivka in Melitopol district?
method: The collection waypoint tree, catalog film notes, item ranges, image-group metadata, title frames, and representative primary frames at the beginning and end of the two catalog-linked items were inspected in an authenticated FamilySearch session.
findings: Collection 2465061 contains 62,154 images, but its waypoint tree is limited to Yekaterinoslav province, Alexandrovsk district, and State Archive of Zaporizhzhia Region fond 12, opis 2. It is not a Melitopol-district revision collection.

Catalog 1282852 exposes only two narrow film-note rows rather than complete district revisions: 1835 file 134-2-689, pages 360-361, DGS 004922550 item 2; and 1850 file 134-2-627, pages 3-5, DGS 005783099 item 3.

DGS 005783099 item 3 occupies images 556-564. Its image-group title and metadata identify Luzhanka, Akkerman district, Bessarabia, and the first frame of the item is a new-item slate. This is not Tymoshivka or Melitopol district.

DGS 004922550 item 2 occupies images 356-821 and is a mixed item titled colonies. Its image-group contents list Bender, Alexandrovsk, Odessa, Tiraspol, Ananyev, Akkerman, and Cahul jurisdictions. The title frame and representative opening and closing revision sheets do not identify Tymoshivka or a separate Melitopol-district block.

The repeated archival numbers 134-2-627 and 134-2-689 across mixed custodians created a misleading catalog association. Neither digital address can be used as a complete revision of Tymoshivka or as a negative surname test.

evidence.title: Ukraine, Zaporizhia, Poll Tax Census (Revision Lists), 1811-1858
evidence.result: Waypoint tree limited to Alexandrovsk district.

evidence.title: FamilySearch catalog 1282852
evidence.result: Only two film-note fragments, not complete Melitopol-district revisions.

evidence.title: DGS 005783099 item 3, first frame
evidence.result: Authenticated metadata identifies Luzhanka, Akkerman district, Bessarabia.

evidence.title: DGS 004922550 item 2
evidence.result: Mixed colonies image group; no separately identified Tymoshivka or Melitopol-district item.

assessment.confidence: high for the scope of collection 2465061 and the identity of the 1850 item; high that catalog 1282852 is not a complete Tymoshivka revision; medium for excluding an unlabelled Melitopol fragment somewhere inside the mixed 1835 item
assessment.whatWouldConfirm: An archive inventory or image-group title that explicitly identifies Tymoshivka, Melitopol district, with a complete revision sheet and the household of Ilya Ivanov son Anpilogov.
assessment.whatWouldRefute: A verified frame inside DGS 004922550 item 2 explicitly headed Tymoshivka or Melitopol district and matching the catalog pages 360-361.

next: Use the prepared first archive order for GARK 26-1-1838 and 26-1-1651, then request revision extracts and attachments from 16-1-247.
Continue locating the original Tymoshivka revision through the Taurida treasury-chamber inventory and cases about the 1809-1810 resettlement, especially GARK 27-1-1014 and 377-1-680.
Do not use surname search inside collection 2465061 as evidence for absence from Tymoshivka.

publicScope.reason: The audit corrects source scope and adds no newly identified bearer of the researched surname series.
